entities.name: Jiří Weil
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Weil was a Czech writer of Jewish origin and Holocaust survivor. His noted works include the two novels Life with a Star, and Mendelssohn Is on the Roof, as well as many short stories, and other novels.
